import json, subprocess, sys
import copy
BASE={"epoch":7,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0}
def run(req):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=(json.dumps(req)+"\n").encode(),capture_output=True,timeout=120)
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode().splitlines()[0])

tests=[]
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["epoch"]=2147483647; tests.append(("epoch max",r,True))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["epoch"]=2147483648; tests.append(("epoch max+1",r,False))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["node_count"]=96; r["edges"]=[]; tests.append(("node_count 96",r,True))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["node_count"]=97; r["edges"]=[]; tests.append(("node_count 97",r,False))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["edges"]=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}]*384; tests.append(("edges 384",r,True))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["edges"]=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}]*385; tests.append(("edges 385",r,False))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["commodities"]=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[],"previous":[]}]*96; tests.append(("commodities 96",r,True))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["commodities"]=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[],"previous":[]}]*97; tests.append(("commodities 97",r,False))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["commodities"]=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}]; tests.append(("demand 1024",r,True))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["commodities"]=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1025,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}]; tests.append(("demand 1025",r,False))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["edges"]=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1024}]; r["commodities"]=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}]; tests.append(("cap 1024",r,True))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["edges"]=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1025}]; r["commodities"]=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}]; tests.append(("cap 1025",r,False))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["budget"]=98304; tests.append(("budget max",r,True))
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["budget"]=98305; tests.append(("budget max+1",r,False))
# 16 paths per commodity, distinct edges needed -> use 16 parallel edges
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["edges"]=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}]*16
r["commodities"]=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[i] for i in range(16)],"previous":[1]*16}]
tests.append(("16 paths",r,True))
r2=copy.deepcopy(r); r2["commodities"]=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[i] for i in range(16)]+[[0]],"previous":[1]*17}]
tests.append(("17 paths",r2,False))
# 768 paths total: 48 commodities x 16 paths
r=copy.deepcopy(BASE); r["edges"]=[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}]*16
r["commodities"]=[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[[i] for i in range(16)],"previous":[1]*16} for _ in range(48)]
tests.append(("768 paths",r,True))
r["commodities"].append({"source":0,"target":1,"demand":0,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]})
tests.append(("769 paths",r,False))
bad=0
for name,req,expect_valid in tests:
    resp=run(req)
    valid = resp.get("status")!="invalid"
    ok = (valid==expect_valid)
    if not ok: bad+=1
    print("%-18s expect_valid=%-5s got=%-10s %s" % (name, expect_valid, resp.get("status"), "OK" if ok else "MISMATCH"))
print("bad",bad)
PYEOF
